body:
I agree with HolonProduction's reasoning. Since we're unlikely to be able to measure any noticeable performance differences in practice, the main concern is the differences between `Vector` and `LocalVector` (signed vs unsigned indices, choosing the correct assignment operator, `ptrw()` vs `ptr()`).

But fortunately, the `GDScriptInstance::members` field is used in only a few places, so I was able to check them all fairly quickly. The changes appear correct to me. So, I think this PR is worth merging, even though the performance gains appear very small and are based solely on theoretical considerations.
